data.one_liner: Check iOS, Android, and Mac store versions and show update alerts.
data.what_it_does: Checks the application version available on the iOS App Store, Google Play Store, or Mac App Store against the currently installed version. Provides a built-in update alert dialog if a newer version is available.
use_when: You need to prompt users to update their app when a new version is released on official stores.
You want a straightforward way to fetch the latest store version and open the download URL.
avoid_when: You require complex in-app update flows managed natively via Google Play In-App Updates API.
You need detailed platform-specific update mechanics not covered by basic web scraping and store API lookups.
strengths: Simple API to initialize and check versions via a single method call.
Supports iOS, Android, and macOS platforms out of the box.
weaknesses: Relies on web page scraping and store lookups which can break if store layouts change.
Limited customization options for the update flow beyond provided parameters.
data.setup_notes: No special native permissions required, but depends on network connectivity to fetch store metadata.
